baseline.description: Naive baseline on the same buildings and the same number of cleaners: k-means territories by building count (no workload balancing), round-robin day patterns that still respect each building's frequency, and nearest-neighbour walking routes from the same kind of start point.

cost.note: List price as of 2026-11 (Routes API Compute Route Matrix, assumed $5 per 1,000 elements after 10,000 free elements per month), verify at developers.google.com/maps/billing-and-pricing/pricing. Cluster-first planning only needs the matrix inside each territory, so a full refresh costs Σ(territory size)² elements instead of N².
